title: cleisostoma brevilabium
intro: Cleisostoma brevilabium, commonly known as the blue helmet orchid, is a species of orchid native to tropical Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cleisostoma brevilabium include wound healing, pain relief, and anti-cancer activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
